description: This Java source file defines the AnswerController class, a REST controller in a Spring Boot application that manages CRUD operations for 'Answer' entities related to questions. It provides endpoints to get, add, update, and delete answers associated with specific questions.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing endpoints to manage answers related to questions, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all answers for a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new answer to a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer associated with a question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer by its ID, associated with a specific question.
